notes: Retest mode: ran the full backend pytest suite first, then re-ran every browser check named in iteration_8 plus the ones added mid-cycle (reply-composer-turn-error-retry, scorecard-category-deltas-render) by name only, then added 4 new browser checks for this iteration's voice-lifecycle acceptance criteria (mic pause/resume, voice-playback-failure retry, end-during-slow-load no delayed audio, navigate-away cleanup).

Backend suite first attempt returned 9 setup errors, all '429 Too many sign-up attempts' from the in-memory per-process rate bucket (lib/auth.py _BUCKETS) being exhausted by this same testing session's earlier rapid pytest runs against a backend process that had not restarted; this is test-harness-induced exhaustion of a working rate limiter, not an application defect. Restarted the backend supervisor process (clears the in-memory bucket) and reran the suite clean: 32 passed.

The hint endpoint's null/empty-coach-result -> 502 branch (routers/simulations.py get_hint, 'The coach had nothing useful to add.') was verified by direct code reading rather than live HTTP forcing, since deterministically starving the LLM coach of a usable answer isn't reachable from a black-box HTTP client without mocking the LLM call, which the black-box-over-HTTP testing rule for this suite does not permit. The other four hint-endpoint sub-criteria (200 on L1-2, 409 on >2, 401 anonymous, 404 cross-user) are all live-HTTP verified in test_tscheck_hint_endpoint_flow.py.

navigate-away-from-live-call-cleans-up drives the SPA route change via window.history.pushState + a manually dispatched 'popstate' event rather than page.goto, because a full page.goto would trigger a real browser unload (destroying the JS context outright) and trivially satisfy 'no further requests fire' without ever exercising React's own effect-cleanup path; the history/popstate approach is exactly the mechanism react-router's BrowserHistory listens to, so it is a faithful SPA navigation, not a page reload.

Both flaky results (coaching-report-full-render, skill-module-prepare-remember-list) failed on their first named re-run with plain timeouts (60s waitForURL / 20s toBeVisible) and passed cleanly on an immediate, unmodified re-run; consistent with the briefing's stated 10-40s grading/LLM latency variance in this environment, not a functional regression.

spec_deviations from the briefing (headless has no real mic so recognition capture itself isn't exercised, decorative index keys, bearer token in localStorage, anonymous 401 on /api/auth/me, no further component-splitting this pass) remain accepted as intentional, not flagged as bugs.

Console noise across all checks was limited to the expected anonymous 401 probe on GET /api/auth/me, expected 409s from intentional concurrency/hard-stop tests, and the expected 502/non-audio-200 injected by this iteration's own route interceptions.
